notes: Modified cash basis city, same layout and choices as FY2023. Governmental lines from the governmental funds statement Total Governmental Funds column (pp5-6); fund balances 986,906 / 857,860 in the fund-balance fields; roll-forward ties (986,906 + 1,329,236 - 1,532,320 + 273,656 - 199,618 = 857,860). ending_cash = government-wide governmental 'Cash and equity in pooled cash' 678,137 (p1, net of deficit equity in pooled cash); CDs 138,285 in ending_investments; beginning_investments = 2021 Totals time deposits 138,043 on the governmental funds statement (p4); no prior-year governmental cash on the same basis printed, so beginning_cash null. Taxes 426,126 split using the fund schedules (General p14, Street p16, City Sales Tax p18, Debt Service p19); Other Governmental Funds taxes 73,994 (Library, Police, Fire, Park) have no printed breakdown and stay 'Taxes'. Intergovernmental 279,373: state tax credit 5,604 (Debt Service p19) split out; remainder 273,769 (General state aid 14,229, Street 173,480, ARP Fund 81,060, Fire 5,000) kept as intergovernmental. Grant income 349,260 is the Cather CDBG State CDBG block grant (p20). Business-type lines from the modified cash proprietary statement (pp8-9, Totals column; its column header misprints the year as 2021 but the comparative column is the 2021 one); disbursements total 1,763,649 printed on the Statement of Activities (p2) = operating 1,742,391 + principal 18,805 + interest 2,453; receipts total computed; roll-forward ties (1,977,450 + 2,177,703 - 1,763,649 - 74,038 = 2,317,466). Pages 10-11 accrual proprietary statement used only for utility fund detail (as FY2023/FY2024); proprietary cash flows (pp12-13) not recorded (non-GAAP report, as later years). Transportation 170 kept as other (context label; user ruling 2026-11-12). Detail: budget-and-actual schedules for General, Street, City Sales Tax, Debt Service, Cather CDBG (pp14-20; zero-actual budget-only lines omitted), nonmajor combining statement per fund (pp21-22; Unemployment transfer printed 0 omitted), utility funds from the accrual statement fund columns (pp10-11). Balance sheet from the government-wide Statement of Net Position - Modified Cash Basis (p1). Read pages 1-22 of 22
